visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) HanHan holds a shredded pink and multicolored fabric bundle (a pillow), mimicking a crying expression while wearing a grey sweater; large pink captions appear over the tattered fabric. (2) Close-up shots show the frayed edges and colorful loose threads of the pillow, which HanHan points at while explaining the damage in a bright indoor room. (3) HanHan visits a textile shop and interacts with a staff member in a pink shirt; they review patterns on a computer monitor and look at fabric swatches. (4) A large-scale digital printer is shown processing white fabric with a repeating pink zig-zag pattern; HanHan compares the new print with her original pillow. (5) HanHan handles various fabric samples and displays a previously made colorful pillowcase; a heat press machine is shown pressing the new pink pattern onto fabric. (6) At a tailor shop, an older woman wearing a white coat and glasses sews the new fabric using a JUKI sewing machine while HanHan watches in a pink mask. (7) HanHan holds the completed, newly encased pillow which features a clean pink and white pattern; she spins around joyfully on a city street. (8) Inside a car, HanHan examines the neat, reinforced seams of the 'reborn' pillow, looking closely at the stitching details on the pink fabric.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: (阿甜：我變好破喔...). [Variety]: 3天拯救 30年破枕頭. (2) [Slogan]: 布料 客製化印刷 3天完成. [Variety]: 阿甜 整形日記. (3) [Variety]: 嘿~. [Subtitle]: 你的囡囡枕跟小被被破到不行嗎? (4) [Subtitle]: 我30年的囡囡枕又破了 這是我第3次來拯救阿甜 因為我真的太愛摳了. (5) [Subtitle]: 結果他現在整個翻起來了 怎麼變那麼破啊. (6) [Subtitle]: 先提供要印製的圖檔給老闆 如果沒有圖檔的話 記得先預約哦 預留時間. (7) [Subtitle]: 可以把你的囡囡枕本體 帶給店家確認 還有看布. (8) [Subtitle]: 再來在現場和店家修圖對色. (9) [Subtitle]: 布料挑選完成 以及圖檔沒問題 就可以打樣試印確認. (10) [Subtitle]: 看一下圖案 大致上沒問題 只是因為是打樣 所以顏色會比較淡一點. (11) [Subtitle]: 除了內裡 其實在2年前 我也把外面的枕頭套 有重新再做數位印刷 (吸). (12) [Subtitle]: 因為店家只有姊姊一個人 所以一定要預約確認時間喔 最後就可以帶著 印好的布和本體. (13) [Subtitle]: 請專業阿姨縫製 破布枕頭阿甜 重獲新生. (14) [Subtitle]: 阿甜：好惹~~~. [Variety]: 嘿~. (15) [Subtitle]: 只是這個收邊收得好乾淨 我是不是就沒有地方 可以讓我 摳手手.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Loud, high-pitched female wailing and crying sounds; no background music is audible during this initial distress call. (2) A fast-paced, upbeat electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat enters; a female voice begins a rapid-fire narration with high pitch and enthusiastic energy. (3) A sequence of sharp 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects marks visual transitions; the narration continues over a steady bed of rhythmic synthesizers. (4) A clearly audible, exaggerated sniffing sound (inhale) is followed by a soft, satisfied exclamation; the BGM remains constant in tempo. (5) Mechanical clunking and the escaping hiss of a heat press machine are heard; these are layered beneath the high-energy vocal delivery. (6) The rhythmic, high-frequency whirring of a sewing machine motor becomes dominant; the female voice adopts a professional yet friendly explanatory tone. (7) A bright, shimmering 'sparkle' SFX accompanies an excited exclamation; the BGM reaches a crescendo with more layered electronic textures. (8) The ambient hum of a car interior with low-frequency engine noise is audible; the female voice speaks in a casual, conversational tone with a humorous inflection.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the emotional restoration of a 30-year-old childhood pillow through custom textile printing and professional tailoring, showcasing the step-by-step service from fabric selection to the finished product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides detailed instructions on how to book an appointment, the 3-day turnaround time, and explicitly shows the service process at a specific textile shop.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses the 'sentimental object' trope to promote a custom fabric printing service, blending personal vlog style with informative product demonstration.
